summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a 727KB obfuscated payload unrelated to the chatbot UI
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a platform-specific Bun binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13) into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. No hash or signature verification is performed. math_init.js is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` file with hex-named identifiers, a large decoder table, and an obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation routine (`WV8StW`); its filename and content do not correspond to the package's advertised chatbot-client purpose. The alien-runtime execution path means the obfuscated payload runs at `npm install` under Bun rather than Node, evading Node-based inspection of install-time code. Distinct from a legitimate Bun/Chromium-style runtime install because the fetched runtime is used solely to execute an opaque bundled script whose function is unrelated to the package's declared purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
